obligations.requirement: Demo camera pan and anchored zoom are deterministic, invertible, and per-view only.
obligations.oracle: World-to-view and view-to-world round trips, pan direction, zoom-anchor invariance, invalid input rejection, and monotonic camera generation.
obligations.acceptance: All exact and tolerance-based transform assertions pass without semantic or RuntimeScene mutation.

obligations.requirement: Demo hit/select delegates to the G2 Scene hit-test contract instead of reimplementing precise hit testing.
obligations.oracle: A real Scene fixture proves spatial candidates are examined before precise tests and the selected ID follows G2 front-to-back ordering.
obligations.acceptance: The demo adapter issues one G2 HitTestRequest at the camera-derived world point and returns the G2-selected ObjectId.

obligations.requirement: Selection is demo-only transient state and cannot change canonical semantic or RuntimeScene identity/content.
obligations.oracle: Capture semantic generation, Scene revision/content digest, and RuntimeScene generation/content digest before selection; assert all remain identical while the transient overlay snapshot changes.
obligations.acceptance: Only transient selection generation/overlay digest changes.

obligations.requirement: G3-08 introduces no production editor/session semantics and preserves G2 plus G3-01 through G3-07.
obligations.oracle: Authorized-path scan, forbidden dependency/term scan, focused G3 tests, RF01/G2 tests, and git diff check.
obligations.acceptance: All checks pass and no semantic, scene, or existing render contract file changes.
